title: FBI TSC BAE-to-IntelliWare award-sequence research pass — depth 5
summary: Corrected the current-prime classification, enumerated the publicly credited IntelliWare/Agile award team and queued transaction and source-selection reconstruction.

sources.title: Agile Defense Announces $145m Million Intelligence Analysis Contract
Agile Defense Wins $145M Contract for FBI Threat Screening Center

data.research_question: What later award and public personnel evidence supersedes the BAE-current-prime interpretation?
data.method: Current award-record comparison, official company release review, official company-post personnel extraction and strict mechanism boundaries.
classification_rules: A later active award corrects current-awardee status but does not prove the mechanism affecting the earlier award.
An award-team credit establishes participation in the corporate award effort, not a formal contract title.
TSC intelligence-analysis award status does not prove FBI-TSC-AIE response status.

findings.finding: IntelliWare is the current active TSC Intelligence Analysis Services awardee under 15F06726F0000362.
BAE was the initial 2025 awardee and bridge recipient.
The later award resulted from a specific protest, termination or corrective action.
Agile Defense publicly credited seven named people on the IntelliWare award team.
IntelliWare or Agile Defense responded to FBI-TSC-AIE.
